why: This is a named software-and-hardware toolchain that others can adopt, rather than a general instructional element or a course-specific instructional design.
name: H3D API and Novint Falcon haptic toolchain
product_description: An open-source H3D API for linking 3D graphics with haptic rendering, paired with Novint Technologies' consumer Novint Falcon haptic controller for building visuo-haptic simulations.
